purpose: Local fixed-point comparison from identical near-converged density; not independent cold starts or timing benchmarks.

controller_resumes.reason: First upstream attempt ended with rank 4 SIGSEGV and MPI cleanup SIGKILLs; retry identical calculations with unlimited process stack and OMP_STACKSIZE=256M. Retain the failed attempt under archives.
Execute remaining pending controlled calculations with unlimited process stack and OMP_STACKSIZE=256M; retain completed results and any excluded attempts in the archive.

output_precision_note: dUele, NormRD and criterion are printed with 12 decimals. A final displayed dUele=1e-12 may round an internal value below 1e-12. Actual early SCF exit is checked together with the unmodified source stopping predicate.
additional_precision_control: Native FP64 GPU grid/orbital/GEMM arithmetic, retaining inherited CPU VNA/force float products to isolate the GPU precision-policy difference.

notes: All routes start from separate copies of one near-converged restart, with a fixed 0.3 Hamiltonian mixing weight and no Pulay steps. This tests local fixed-point agreement, not independent cold-start convergence.
The SCF test bounds band-energy change and the mixing residual, not total-energy error.
The native FP64 route disables both scf.fp32.enable and scf.gemmul8.enable; this also promotes legacy CPU VNA/force products. Orbital/projector storage remains unchanged.
The default Radeon route retains automatic arithmetic policies. Actual GPU dense admission/fallback and precision banners are recorded per run.
All calculations use unlimited process stack and OMP_STACKSIZE=256M. The archived initial upstream attempt with the default 8 MiB process stack failed before publishing numerical results.
